excerpts.text: On September 25, 1789, with a two-thirds majority, Congress approved a final version and sent 12 proposed amendments to the states for ratification.
Although 12 amendments were sent to the states for ratification, only 10 were ratified and adopted at that time—we now know them as our Bill of Rights.
